content_sections.heading: DHSGSU Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the DHSGSU Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/ salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download DHSGSU Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: DHSGSU Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 4 vacancies are available - 1 for Aeronautical Engineering (Aircraft Structures & Materials), 1 for Electronics & Communication Engineering, 1 for Mechanical Engineering and 1 for Mathematics.

content_sections.heading: DHSGSU Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Aeronautical Engineering (Aircraft Structures & Materials): B.E./ B.Tech./ B.S. & M.E./ M.Tech in relevant branch, First class or equivalent. Electronics & Communication Engineering: B.E./ B.Tech./ B.S. & M.E./ M.Tech in relevant branch, First class or equivalent. Mechanical Engineering: B.E./ B.Tech./ B.S. & M.E./ M.Tech in relevant branch, First class or equivalent. Mathematics: M.Sc. in Mathematics, Ph.D/ NET as per UGC Norms.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for DHSGSU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Guest Faculty positions at Dr Harisingh Gour Vishwavidyalaya Sagar is scheduled for 01 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they report on this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Guest Faculty post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies for the Guest Faculty positions announced by Dr Harisingh Gour Vishwavidyalaya Sagar in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this DHSGSU recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates are required to attend the interview directly on the specified date and venue.

faq.question: Q4. What are the essential qualifications for the Guest Faculty positions?
faq.answer: Qualifications vary by post. For engineering disciplines, B.E./B.Tech./B.S. & M.E./M.Tech in the relevant branch with first class is required. For Mathematics, M.Sc. with Ph.D/NET as per UGC norms is necessary.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for DHSGSU Guest Faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: As per the provided information, there is no application fee mentioned for General/OBC categories. It is advisable to check the official notification for any specific details.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for these Guest Faculty roles?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Guest Faculty positions at Dr Harisingh Gour Vishwavidyalaya Sagar will be based on a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q7. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at Dr Harisingh Gour Vishwavidyalaya Sagar, Madhya Pradesh. The exact venue details will be available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if applicable), and category certificates, along with one set of self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for these Guest Faculty positions?
faq.answer: The Guest Faculty positions are contractual in nature, meaning they are temporary appointments for a specified period.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from outside Madhya Pradesh apply?
faq.answer: The notification does not specify any domicile restrictions. Eligible candidates from all regions are encouraged to apply, provided they meet the educational qualifications and other criteria.
